name: unreal, not real
definition: The world or things in it seem unreal, fake or artificial, or as if they do not exist.
comment: Things can look fake or artificial; chatgpt G53 (real and unreal together) and G69 (facade over appearances) attached: half their texts are in claude G01, both fail the rules alone.

name: dreamlike, in a dream
definition: The world or one's life seems like a dream or like being in a dream.
comment: A scene can look dreamlike.

name: movie, picture, film set
definition: The world appears as a film, picture or staged scene that is being viewed rather than lived.
comment: A scene can look like a picture, film or staged set.

name: simulation, video game
definition: The world seems to be a simulation, video game or other digital or virtual reality.
comment: A scene can look rendered or computer-generated.

name: veil, glass wall, barrier, bubble
definition: Something like a veil, film, pane of glass, invisible wall or enclosing bubble seems to stand between the person and the world.
comment: Merged claude G06 (bubble): 100% of its texts are in chatgpt G09 (wall or barrier); one quality, a separating layer between person and world.

name: fog, blurry, hazy
definition: The world appears foggy, blurred, cloudy or indistinct.
comment: Fog, blur and haze are properties of the visible scene.

name: detached, cut off from world
definition: The person feels disconnected, separated or cut off from the world, not part of it or immersed in it.
comment: A felt relation (not part of or immersed in the world), not a property of the scene; its visible forms are A05 (barrier), A10 (distance). chatgpt G57 (not directly presented) attached: 58% of its texts in claude G08.

name: watching as detached observer
definition: The world is experienced as something watched from outside, as a spectator or onlooker rather than a participant.
comment: A spectator stance of the person, not a property of the scene; the visible form (scene as film or picture) is A03.

name: far away, distant
definition: People, objects or the world seem remote, far off or out of reach.
comment: Things can look far away.

name: flat, two-dimensional
definition: Objects, people or the world look flat and lacking depth.
comment: Things can look flat, without depth.

name: altered size of objects
definition: Objects or spaces look larger, smaller or otherwise changed in size compared with how they really are.
comment: Objects can look larger or smaller than they are.

name: dull, less vivid, colorless
definition: The world appears dimmed, faded or reduced in color, vividness and intensity.
comment: Colour, brightness and vividness are properties of the scene.

name: lifeless, dead, empty
definition: The world or the things in it appear dead, lifeless, empty or void.
comment: A scene can look dead, lifeless or empty.

name: heightened, vivid, more real
definition: The world appears brighter, sharper, more intense, more detailed or more real than usual.
comment: A scene can look brighter, sharper, more detailed or more intense.

name: strange, foreign, uncanny
definition: The world or things in it feel strange, odd, alien or eerie.
comment: A scene can look strange or eerie. chatgpt G63 (eerie, nightmarish) attached: 56% of its texts in claude G16.

name: familiar looks unfamiliar
definition: Known places, people or objects no longer look or feel familiar, as if seen for the first time.
comment: Familiar things can look unfamiliar, as if seen for the first time.

name: no emotional resonance
definition: The world, its objects and its beauty no longer evoke feeling, interest or a sense of mattering to the person.
comment: The person's affective response (nothing evokes feeling), not a property of the scene; the visible counterpart is A13.

name: meaningless, things without names
definition: Things appear stripped of their ordinary meaning, name or relevance, reduced to bare shapes or mere existence.
comment: Things can look like bare shapes, stripped of their usual meaning (chatgpt G66, shapes and formal details, 81% vision).

name: special meaning, significance
definition: Objects, events or the world seem charged with a special meaning or to be communicating something to the person.
comment: An attribution of meaning, not a property of the scene.

name: others as robots, automatons
definition: Other people appear as robots, automatons, dolls, zombies or actors rather than living, feeling beings.
comment: People in a scene can look like dolls, robots or mannequins.

name: disconnected from other people
definition: The person feels emotionally distant from other people, unable to feel attached to them or understand them.
comment: A feeling towards other people, not a property of the scene.

name: others watching, threatening
definition: Other people seem to be watching, judging, threatening, influencing or intruding upon the person.
comment: Being watched or influenced by others is a social belief, not a property of the scene.

name: oneness, connectedness with world
definition: The person feels unusually connected to or at one with other people, humanity or the universe.
comment: A feeling of connection, not a property of the scene.

name: blurred self/world boundaries
definition: The boundary between oneself and other people or objects seems blurred or permeable, so that things merge with the self.
comment: A self-world boundary experience, not a property of the scene.

name: time faster or slower
definition: Time seems to pass faster or slower than normal.
comment: Time.

name: time stopped, eternal
definition: Time seems to have stopped, to be suspended or to last forever.
comment: Time.

name: present, past seem displaced
definition: Events feel misplaced in time, so that the recent seems long ago, the present seems like a past memory, or past, present and future are hard to tell apart.
comment: Time. chatgpt G30 (time unreliable, disordered) attached: same quality (past, present and future hard to tell apart).

name: doubt in common-sense reality
definition: The reality or existence of the world is doubted, or held alongside an alternate reality, rather than taken for granted.
comment: Doubt about reality is a belief, not a property of the scene. chatgpt G54 (alternate realities) attached: 53% of its texts in claude G31, and the claude definition already includes an alternate reality.

name: not noticing surroundings
definition: The person is less aware of the surroundings and misses or fails to notice what is going on around them.
comment: Reduced awareness of the surroundings, not a property of the scene.

name: seeing things not present
definition: Things such as spots, patterns, sounds or images are perceived although they are not actually there.
comment: Spots, patterns or images that are not there can be seen.

name: frightening, sinister, repulsive
definition: The world or things in it feel menacing, horrifying, nightmarish or disgusting.
comment: A scene can look menacing, nightmarish or repulsive.

name: visually distorted
definition: The visible world, shapes, size, or distance appear distorted.
comment: chatgpt only (claude put these texts in OTHER). Shapes, size or distance look distorted.

name: distinctness and differences lost
definition: Objects or things lose their individuality, distinctness, or differences from one another.
comment: chatgpt only (claude put these texts in OTHER). Objects look alike, without their individual differences (100% vision).
